text: 在深圳旅途的地图上点精灵，唤它跳一下。完成好习惯或积累经验，它会依次留下发光脚印、引来流萤，还能把星星连成星座。看路牌找到下一盏灯，沿海看鸥鸟，进城看树叶随风飘过。

Call your companion right on the trail. Personal habit days or companion XP unlock glowing tracks, fireflies, and a constellation. Follow the sign to the next lamp as gulls cross the bay and leaves drift through the city.
